items.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge accelerated to 3.8% in October, likely sealing rate hike
items.description: The personal consumption expenditures price index was expected to show an annual inflation rate of 3.8% in October, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

items.title: Trump’s meddling in Huang scandal reignites voter angst over tech’s outsized political power

items.title: The Fed is likely to raise rates in December. What it means for your holiday spending

items.title: Secondhand shopping is going mainstream this holiday season as consumers seek value

items.title: Ukraine tells Putin to ‘stop complaining’ over oil refinery attacks as Russia promises retaliation

items.title: China’s Xiamen Airlines to buy 50 Boeing jets in $7.4 billion deal
